title: Alpha oxygen – a unique oxidation active site from a quantum chemical viewpoint

Stepan Sklenak, Jiri Dedecek
Alpha oxygen [M(IV)O]2+ (M = Fe, Co, Mn, Ni) stabilized in zeolites is highly reactive. It can selectively oxidize CH4 to CH3OH at room temperature and can be prepared by splitting either N2O or O2 over some transition metal exchanged zeolites.
